_comment: The random-event deck. One is drawn each time the commissioner advances the round.
Add your own freely — nothing here is referenced by name in code except `effect.kind`,
which must be one of: CASH (flat money), CASH_PER_POKEMON, VALUE_SPIKE (one Pokémon's
market value moves), TYPE_SHIFT (every Pokémon of a type moves), TAX (a share of cash).
`weight` is relative — an event with weight 4 is twice as likely as one with weight 2.
`scope` is `team` (picks one team at random) or `league` (everyone).

events.title: Sponsorship deal
events.description: A Silph Co. rep liked what they saw. {team} banks ₽{amount}.

events.title: Packed house
events.description: Ticket sales are up across the league. Every team takes ₽{amount}.

events.title: Merchandise run
events.description: {team} sells plushies of the whole squad — ₽{amount} per Pokémon.

events.title: Luxury tax
events.description: The league takes {percent}% of every team's cash pile.

events.title: Breakout star
events.description: {pokemon} is all over the highlight reels — value up {percent}%.

events.title: Form slump
events.description: Nobody wants {pokemon} right now — value down {percent}%.

events.title: Metagame shift
events.description: {type}-types are everywhere this week — their value moves {percent}%.

events.title: Counter-meta
events.description: Everyone's packing answers to {type}-types — their value moves {percent}%.

events.title: Exhibition prize
events.description: {team} won a side tournament and pockets ₽{amount}.
